interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures or lower speed limits to better align with the adjacent park land use.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians accessing the park.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a vertical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, while also improving the visual environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street-level lighting to improve visibility and the sense of security, especially given the blank building frontage.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected phase for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to the right-side sidewalk buffer to provide shade and improve the psychological comfort of the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Active Ground Floor Uses
interventions.description: Incorporate windows or retail space into the building frontage to increase 'eyes on the street' and pedestrian engagement.
